title: HIS WHOLE LIFE WAS A LIE 🎭
topic: The betrayal of a simulated reality

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: YOU LOCK THE DOORS [beat] BUT THE CAMERAS ARE STILL STREAMING EVERY SINGLE SECOND OF THIS TRAP DIRECTLY TO THE WORLD!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Sit down Nix [beat] because you finally realized that your entire childhood has just been a scripted season of a viral show.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I thought we were a real family [beat] but you turned my private trauma into a paycheck for some faceless internet fans!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Don't be so dramatic little brother [beat] the ratings are higher than they’ve ever been since you discovered the hidden room.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Even Tuli is in on this [beat] and I bet Mom and Dad are just waiting for their cue to walk onto the set and take a bow!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: The sponsors are paying millions for this finale [beat] so keep your face toward the ring light and finish your scripted lines!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: The neighbors have been voting on your choices for weeks [beat] and they really didn't like your attitude in the kitchen last night!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I'm not a character in your twisted game [beat] and I am leaving this fake studio right now before the stream goes offline!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The exit door is actually just a painted prop [beat] and the audience is currently betting on how long it takes for Nix to break.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: We did it all for your future Nix [beat] because being a normal teenager doesn't pay the bills in this digital economy anymore!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I will break every single camera in this basement [beat] until there is nothing left for your sick followers to watch today!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: That would be a great season finale [beat] but unfortunately for you the true director of this series hasn't even arrived yet!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The script demands one final sacrifice [beat] and the countdown to the real ending starts in exactly five seconds from now.
